Hide.description: The rugged, thick hide of an elephantine creature, imbued with a natural resilience to blunt force, exudes a pungent musk and promises a rewarding harvest through careful skimming.

Shell.description: This hard, gleaming shell is a natural fortress, thick as iron and sharp as thorns, harvested with careful saws from turtle backs or snail domes, offering unparalleled protection to those who wield it.
